criteria.rationale: Born June 25, 1998, the patient was 28 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The PA request specifies chronic weight management, and the requested order is for Wegovy.
The August 20 note documents continued calorie tracking, meal preparation, and swimming, with instructions to continue the plan when starting Wegovy.
Enrollment began December 20, 2025, and follow-up documents continued diet, activity, and program participation through August 20, 2026—eight whole calendar months without a documented interruption.
The latest structured BMI before the request is 26.9, below the minimum of 27 even with documented dyslipidemia.
